newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products steady, except firmer gasoline.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady, except firmer gasoline.

text.p: NWE oil products were broadly steady, bar firmer gasoline on Thursday, traders said.

Gas oil firmed 25 cents in line with August IPE. A German heating oil cargo moved unchanged at August IPE +$1.25. Barges were dormant with prompt Rotterdam refinery stable at August IPE flat to +$0.50.
Gasoline barge and swap values were up by $1-$2 on renewed bidding for very prompt barge barrels at a fresh high of $199.
In the absence of early reported deals, however, some dealers began to describe the market as overcooked and ready for some erosion.
August naphtha swaps were meanwhile seen marginally lower at $185.50-$186 on a slightly lower crude futures and a very quiet start to naphtha trading.
September and October values meanwhile remained steady and in parity at $184.50-$185 as offers as high as $185.50 were mentioned.
High sulphur fuel barges were broadly flat with $90.25 traded fob Rotterdam and $91.00 done fob Antwerp.
